subject.statement: Michael B. Jordan, the actor, played basketball for the Chicago Bulls.

summary: Verdict: FALSE – Michael B. Jordan never played for the Chicago Bulls; decisive facts: his primary profession is actor (per basketballnetwork.net, 2026-03-16) and his occupational profile lists only actor, director, producer with no sports participation (per Wikipedia, undated).

findings.statement: Michael B. Jordan's full name is Michael Bakari Jordan and his primary profession is actor.
Michael B. Jordan has no recorded participation as a player on any professional sports team, including the Chicago Bulls, according to his occupational listing as actor, director, producer.
